However, infections include Newcastle disease, Salmonella, and Coccidiosis gravely affect chicken health and economic stability. Conventional diagnosis methods can call for time-consuming laboratory procedures postponing fast treatments. This article suggests a deep learning-based automated and efficient solution based on faecal images for poultry disease identification. We examined a collection of 6,812 faecal images from four classes—Coccidiosis, Salmonella, Newcastle disease, and healthy poultry—which contained 1,361 for validation and 5,451 images for training. A pre-trained MobileNetV2 model was tuned for classification using hyperparameters including a learning rate of 1e-5, batch size of 64, dropout rate of 0.2, and the Adam optimizer. The model derived 94% accuracy with F1 score, precision, and recall values of 0.944, 0.943, and 0.944, respectively. Training made use of early stopping; the model converged in seven epochs, therefore demonstrating efficient learning. The confusion matrix investigation revealed high accuracy over all classes with a modest misclassification bias against minority classes. The results of this work emphasize the possibilities of deep learning in automating illness diagnosis in poultry farming since they present a scalable, non-invasive, fast solution. Using this approach will help vets and farmers to provide accurate and fast diagnosis, hence lowering death rates and improving poultry health control. This study emphasizes the transforming power of artificial intelligence in agriculture, therefore opening the path for sophisticated instruments in environmentally friendly farming methods.

articleTitle: Design and testing of Hybrid Slime Mold Algorithm for Real-Time Adaptive Mobile Robot Path Planning in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Dynamic path planning and collision prevention is one of the key tasks for autonomous vehicles in relation to dynamic movement of obstacles. In this paper, a novel hybrid approach based on integration of Slime Mold Algorithm (SMA), Triangle Inequality Principle (TIP), and Partition Method Strategy (PMS) for solution of this problem statement. The SMA algorithm is very flexible and adaptive by nature due to its biological working mechanism which is associated with TIP and PMS strategies in relation to their optimization and efficient path planning capabilities and robust solutions. This integrated module is tested in virtual environment and the results are compared with other updated algorithms such as A*, Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for the same static and dynamic environment. It has been observed from the results that this hybrid strategy significantly improves the path planning task several times than other algorithms in terms of multiple aspects. Under testing conditions, the path length was reduced to 25% than other algorithms in a dynamic environment. During this calculation, the computational efficiency of the system has been improved to 60% than conventional methods. The chances of collision have been improved to 34.23% especially in environment where the obstacles are moving. The capability of SMA has been improved due to the synergy between TIP and PMS. The dynamic and adaptive nature of this algorithm is suitable for various applications such as search-and-rescue operations, manufacturing units’ automation and other hazardous environment exploration.

articleTitle: On the Prediction of Temporal Dynamics of Turbulent Flows using a Hybrid Temporal Architecture (TurboNet)
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The accurate predictions of temporal dynamics in turbulent flow remains a formidable challenge in fluid mechanics, owing to the non-linear complexity of governing equations. Traditional numerical methods, while accurate, are computationally prohibitive for high-fidelity simulations over extended time horizons. This study presents TurboNet: a hybrid multi-layer temporal architecture combining Conv1D, LSTM, BiLSTM, that can model the temporal evolution of turbulent flows. To ensure robustness and generalizability, the proposed model is trained and validated on three distinct datasets comprising distinct flow regimes and physical characteristics: Periodic dynamics from in-house URANS simulations of Savonius wind turbine, wall bounded non-linear dynamics from DNS data of channel flow and open-boundary non-linear dynamics from LES data of backward-facing step flow. Evaluation metrics R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> ranging 0.97-0.99 and MSE peaking at 0.2463 demonstrate that the hybrid architecture effectively captures both the periodic and non-linear dynamics with high accuracy while significantly reducing computational cost. The results underscore the potential of ML based frameworks to complement the traditional CFD solvers, enabling efficient and scalable modelling of complex turbulent systems across diverse applications.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Disease Prediction and Doctor Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Healthcare Center can be complicated and of those delayed diagnoses, inefficient referrals, limited specialized care, the remote areas especially. This paper addresses these problems and proposes an AI based Disease Prediction and Doctor Recommendation System powered using advanced machine learning algorithms: These include Decision Trees, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (K-NN). Based on patient’s symptoms and historical health data, the system predicts disease with 98 percent accuracy and suggests the most appropriate specialists for treatment using up to 20 hours of clinical data. The new system will greatly benefit society by improving healthcare accessibility and speed and easy diagnosis and improving the precision of treatment and reducing the number of unnecessary consultations. By integrating its function into telemedicine platforms, hospitals, and patient health apps, it demonstrates the potential for a groundbreaking experience of the healthcare experience while improving outcomes for patients around the globe.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Networks based Bi-LSTM with Sentiment Analysis and Transfer Learning approach for Medicine Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The implementation of an efficient medication recommendation system is indispensable for personalized medicine to improve patient outcomes by providing personalized treatment recommendations. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for medication recommendation based on transfer learning using deep learning methods like Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory networks (Bi-LSTM) along with sentiment analysis of user reviews for opinion mining. The proposed method implements a complex-sequential modeling architecture using an RNN-BiLSTM-driven deep network to model the complex sequential patterns and timing relationships among drug-related data, thereby preparing the system for learning and eventual adaptation based on past usage and feedback. Bi-LSTM retains context-information in both forward and reversed directions to attain better context understanding. Transfer learning implementation of the framework gains the knowledge from pre trained model pertaining to medical recommendation system towards ensuring high generalizability of the developed model. The proposed method essentially binds insights from historical users' data, user sentiments, and advanced deep learning to satisfy patients and treatment outcomes towards a more precise and personalized system for drug recommendations. The dataset required for conducting the experiment was gathered from the Kaggle repository. The experimental results have been validated by various measures such as ROC rate, precision, F1 Score, confusion matrix, and accuracy. The experimental results showed that the proposed method achieved a 97.6% accuracy using the measures considered, which is significantly better than traditional machine learning and deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Floral Classification Revolution: Harnessing Deep Learning for Precision Identification
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: In the light of agriculture and conservation of flora species, it is relevant to understand how computer runs automated flower classification using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). There has been constant pressure of Accreditation in automated identification methods because conventional plant identification methods take time, are tedious and can be tiresome in addition to being inaccurate. Originally, this study is designed to use deep learning technologies to solve the flower species classification problem and, thus, can offer a more optimal solution to support ecological studies, conservation strategies, and farm management. The CNN model developed in this study was trained using a dataset of 4,220 images sourced from Kaggle, representing five distinct flower species: the examples of flowers are daisy, dandelion, roses, sunflowers, and tulips. By adopting the data augmentation techniques, applying image preprocessing and following a structured training strategy, the proposed model was tested to yield a classification accuracy of 74%. By doing so, the results provide preliminary evidence of the suitability of deep learning models for botanical research, and show a definitive improvement since they are much faster and more accurate than conventional techniques used in plant research. Consequently, this study emphasises the benefits of applying AI technologies in environmental tracking, agronomic activities and uses of technology in education. On the one hand, AI in flower classification can break through current approaches to plant species identification, monitoring, and documentation, thereby enhancing the prospects for better protection of biodiversity and more sustainable agro-industrial production. Moreover, conclusions made in this research offer a good basis for further establishment of AI and amalgamation of the latter into different environment sectors to reveal the perspective of future AI development in both research and practice.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Multilingual Intelligent Virtual Assistant
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Every conversational system or goal-oriented dialogue system must have spoken language understanding (SLU), which is a crucial element. To help the user achieve their desired goals, it is essential to comprehend the user's statement. The multilingual intelligent virtual assistant model based techniques for accurately reacting to the user without delay are taken into consideration by many studies in recent days, but very few review articles are available on multilingual virtual assistant. In this study, multilingual intelligent virtual assistant systems were examined. To enhance accuracy and F1 measure regarding the multilingual intelligent virtual assistant model, benefits and downsides of every strategy, challenges and potential areas for future research are observed. The challenges examined in the study such as over fitting issues, lack of datasets, failure in recognizing low resource images, and poor detection performance can be overcome by future researches.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Data Security and Integrity Management Framework for Cyber-Physical Systems Using Hyperledger and Storj
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Modern Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) generate large volumes of sensitive data, requiring secure management. Traditional centralized storage systems are vulnerable to breaches and unauthorized access, making them unsuitable for safeguarding CPS data. This paper presents a blockchain-based architecture integrating Hyperledger Fabric and Storj to enhance data security, integrity, and privacy. Hyperledger Fabric ensures data integrity and transparency through a tamper-proof distributed ledger, fine-grained a ccess c ontrol, a nd automated smart contract protocols. Storj provides decentralized storage, splitting encrypted data into segments across global nodes to eliminate single points of failure and improve redundancy. Experimental evaluation demonstrates a 20% improvement in data retrieval speed, 100% integrity accuracy, and 1,000 transactions per second with minimal CPU usage. Additionally, the integration of homomorphic encryption enables real-time computations on encrypted data while preserving privacy. The proposed framework addresses critical CPS challenges, delivering a scalable, secure, and resilient system for managing CPS data.

articleTitle: Balancing Technology and Personal Care in E-Hospital Services: Achieving Sustainable Healthcare through Digital India
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The e-Hospital framework is a one-stop digital platform that connects patients, doctors, and hospitals via ICT software. The primary goal of the e-Hospital initiative is to apply technology to improve the effectiveness of healthcare for the people of the country, aligning with SDG 3, which aims to provide access to good-quality health services for all. This thereby paves the way to a more sustainable path towards fostering overall health and wellbeing among the beneficiaries. The current study aims to identify and analyze the Features of Patient-Doctor Relationship, Opinions on the Provision and Use of E-Hospital Services, and Factors Influencing the Usage of E-Hospital. This research followed a descriptive research design, and the target population was respondents residing in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. The sampling design used is a non-probability convenience sampling technique. A structured questionnaire with a Likert scale was the primary tool for data collection. The findings highlighted that the respondents claimed that E-Hospital services are a new initiative in the healthcare sector. The factors influencing the usage of E-Hospital services might be based on the health site information, online search, and the possibility to offer opinions about E-Hospital services to government agencies. This initiative enables those using the E-Hospital services to enhance their satisfaction level by benefiting through online health services. The results of the study states that the need of the users to keep on engaged with the E-Hospital services is the most important aspect of factors influencing the usage of E-Hospital, and it will create self-confidence and aid the individuals to be self-reliant towards better usage of the E-Hospital services. The study thus opens up future possibilities for predetermined groups, such as the adoption, loyalty, and satisfaction of users through E-Hospital services.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition Using Conv-LSTM with Infrared Camera Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) the usage of infrared (IR) video statistics leverages superior computer vision and deep gaining knowledge of techniques to detect and classify human activities in numerous environments, even beneath low or no-light situations. This is important for packages including safety, surveillance, and healthcare diagnostics. Deep mastering models, which includes convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, play a substantial position in this technique. CNNs extract spatial features from person frames, while LSTMs model time-structured video sequences, permitting the accurate popularity of complex activities. In this have a look at, the Conv-LSTM version demonstrated superior performance, accomplishing an accuracy of ninety seven.71% on an infrared video dataset. This method outperformed other trendy models, consisting of Enhanced YOLOv5, Attention-primarily based LSTM, Deep Conv-LSTM, and movement recognition models based totally on thermal motion pictures. These outcomes highlight the effectiveness of the Conv-LSTM framework in infrared-based activity popularity, showcasing its potential for actual-time analytics in hard environments.

articleTitle: Automated Classification of Bean Crop Diseases Using Fine-Tuned ResNet50: A Deep Learning Approach for Enhanced Agricultural Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Bean crop diseases substantially lower agricultural productivity since they cause significant losses in production and quality. Early accurate identification of these diseases guarantees food security and helps to lower their load. While considering deep learning techniques to increase the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosis, our work focuses on illness classification in bean leaves. This work uses 8623 photos of bean leaves split into four balanced classes: healthy leaves, angular leaf spot (ALS), bean rust, and unknown class. We employed a modified ResNet50 model for classification. The choice of this architecture was motivated by its established success in picture classification tasks and feature extraction strength. The model was trained and evaluated using this dataset to exhibit an amazing 94% accuracy on the test set, therefore demonstrating its practical use. Since this study provides a reliable, automated method to detect bean crop illnesses, therefore improving crop management methods and maybe reducing the necessity for hand inspections depends significantly on the agricultural sector in this research. This research complements global initiatives aiming at environmental sustainability by supporting innovative agricultural technology, improved food security, and sustainable agriculture itself.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Colon Disease Diagnosis Comprehensive MobileNetV2 Analysis with Biomarkers and Advanced Imaging
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Colon diseases cover a wide and intricate range of ailments that are difficult to detect and treat. Traditional diagnostic approaches, sometimes intrusive and dependent on subjective evaluations, might produce inconsistent outcomes and cause patient discomfort. Colonoscopy, Endoscopy, CT scan (computed tomography) and MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) are recent imaging technology advancements that have significantly improved diagnostic precision and early detection. This study investigates the most recent advances in non-invasive diagnostic procedures, with a special emphasis on the incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) and biomarker methodologies. AI and deep learning (DL) models can evaluate massive volumes of medical data, such as imaging results and medical data, which show nuances and connections that human research might overlook. This study classified a wide collection of four essential categories, including normal, polyps, esophagitis, and ulcerative diseases, using an artificial intelligence-powered tool (MobilenetV2) to improve accuracy and precision that is early detection and encourage specific treatment methods. This system achieved 99.19% training accuracy, 93.55% validation, and 94.25% testing accuracy. By reducing the reliance on invasive procedures, these innovations hold the potential to revolutionize colon disease management and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Predicting Bank Customer Churn: An XGBoost Approach to Enhancing Customer Retention
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: This study applies the XGBoost classifier to analyze the propensity of the banking’s customer churn, by analyzing the dataset containing the basic demographics, financial records, and churn label. Some of the features captured in the dataset include; Surname, Row Number, CustomerID, Credit Score, Gender, Age, Tenure, Account Balance, Credit Card, Number of Products, Geometric Mean, Active Member No., Projected Salary, Exited where Exited = 1, the customer has left the bank. The purpose of present research is to apply the predictive analytics in order to understand what underlying factors serve as indicators of customer attrition and in turn facilitate the better strategies of the relationships’ maintenance. The model scores an average accuracy of 85%, based on 2000 samples, relatively well for predicting non-churning customers (Class 0) with an accuracy of 0.90, recall of 0.93, and an F1 of 0.91. Nevertheless, low accuracy (0,65), recall (0,56), and F1-score (0,60) were received for the churned customers (class 1), which means a high level of false negatives. These results also reveal that the task of identifying churned customers is indeed difficult especially when working with imbalanced data sets. Thus, the macro average performance shows that the model is not very good at generalizing, especially in the case of the minority class. This paper suggests that there is a need for further model improvement including hyperparameters tuning and implementing ways to address the imbalance of class problem to enhance sensitivity in detecting churned customers. Improving the model’s accuracy at identifying ‘at risk’ customers will go a long way to helping refining customer retention strategies for the banking industry, thus helping cut attrition rates and increase overall satisfaction.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Diabetic Foot Ulcer Care through Intelligent CNN-Based Predictions
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Diabetic foot ulcers are a serious consequence of diabetes, affecting about 25% of patients with dire consequences that range from infection and amputation to a decrease in the quality of life. Diabetes mellitus is a major health risk throughout the world, as are its associated issues, including DFUs. Individuals with DFUs have a better chance of recovery if diagnosed as soon as possible. Perhaps machine learning can be used to provide clinical professionals with ideas for identifying and treating patients' conditions. Early detection is considered an important requirement for timely treatment to prevent serious complications while reducing healthcare costs. This paper concerns a new, non-invasive method for the detection of DFUs based on advanced convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and a webcam-based system. It achieves a high accuracy of 97.2%, precision of 96.8%, and recall of 97.5%, ensuring reliable and early ulcer identification. The results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed CNN-based model in predicting diabetic foot ulcers accurately across three stages, namely healthy, early-stage, and severe, thereby having a great potential for early detection and effective medical intervention.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity Threat Intelligence Automated via Machine Learning: A System for Analyzing and Responding to Data in Real-Time
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Businesses are relentlessly bombarded with advanced and ever-evolving attacks in today's rapidly evolving cyber threat landscape. Predefined signatures and rule-based methods to traditional security approaches cannot keep pace with threats of today's magnitude and diversity. The focus of this study is an ML-based real-time threat assessment and response cybersecurity threat intelligence solution. Advanced machine learning algorithms, anomaly detection, and data mining are employed to analyze vast amounts of security information, identify new threats, and respond with instantaneous, effective defense. The system detects intrusion attempts, data exfiltration, and ransomware attacks by analyzing diverse streams of data from security appliances like network logs, endpoint behavior, and traffic patterns. Supervised and unsupervised learning discovers known attack patterns, and anomaly detection discovers new threats. The system learns from new data to detect new attack pathways without rule updates. An automatic response method can isolate compromised devices, ban malicious IP addresses, and warn security personnel in real time, decreasing reaction time and human interaction. Threat intelligence feeds add external context to the system's ability to identify advanced persistent threats (APTs) and other high-level cyberattacks, according to the research. Integration with threat-sharing systems keeps the system updated on threat intelligence, ensuring defensive measures are effective against developing TTPs. The suggested ML-based threat intelligence system speeds up and improves cyber threat detection and response, improving security and allowing organisations to scale their defences in a more complex cyber environment. This paper analyses the system's architecture, performance, and potential for future improvements, such as deep learning models, federated learning for privacy-preserving intelligence sharing, and complex decision-making automation. Machine learning and automation present a viable path towards flexible, scalable, and efficient cybersecurity threat intelligence systems.

articleTitle: Towards Smart Waste Sorting: Lightweight CNN with Attention Mechanisms for Enhanced Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Managing the growing challenges of municipal solid waste is crucial for environmental sustainability, and effective waste management plays a key role in achieving that goal. One promising solution is automating the sorting of refuse, which can greatly improve recycling and overall waste management. However, many current deep learning models that rely on transfer learning suffer from high computational demands and limited adaptability in resource-constrained environments. In this work, we introduce a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) specifically designed to overcome these limitations in trash classification. The model incorporates advanced attention mechanism, namely Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) and Spatial Attention (SA) blocks along with the Mish activation function, collectively augmenting feature representation and optimizing gradient flow. Evaluated on the Kaggle Garbage Dataset, our proposed model achieves a very high classification accuracy of 96.54%, far beyond conventional transfer learning models including VGG16, ResNet50, and EfficientNet B0. With just over 0.8 million parameters and an inference time of only 15 milliseconds per image, the model demonstrates both high computational efficiency and excellent scalability. These results highlight the model’s potential for real-time deployment in resource-limited settings, offering a sustainable and effective alternative for automated waste management. Ultimately, our approach promises to improve garbage classification systems and support more environmentally friendly waste management strategies by leveraging more efficient tools.

articleTitle: An Overview of IoT-based ECG Wavelength Analysis for Remote Patient Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Adopting new IoT technologies holds great potential for changing the patient healthcare landscape. While IoT-enabled healthcare applications have become increasingly popular, it’s important to note that rural areas often face poor healthcare infrastructure and limited access to quality medical care. However, IoT is a valuable asset, especially in emergencies like Covid-19. To make IoT even more helpful in this area, we will explore the existing IoT systems for Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), reveal their shortcomings, and provide systematic fixes. In this study, we look at the advantages of integrating IoT devices with sensors, cloud technologies, and ECG wavelength analysis, particularly in RPM. IoT-enabled devices are adept at collecting and sending real-time information, enabling healthcare professionals to remotely monitor vital signs, essential indicators, and health parameters. While there are challenges associated with empowering remote patient monitoring with IoT, it can also improve healthcare outcomes and reduce costs. This technology fusion provides a glimmer of hope during a pandemic, promoting not only better health but a more fulfilling life. To sum up, this inquiry prepares the ground for a future where healthcare is personalized and patient-centric, with a range of approaches, resilience in the face of failure, and triumphs in overcoming challenges.

Author Keywords: Healthcare and Emergency Situation and Health Alert

articleTitle: Address Resolution Protocol Spoofing Mitigation in Software-Defined Networks using Ryu Controller's Centralized Flow Control
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) spoofing is a severe threat in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) systems, allowing attackers to modify network traffic via Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attacks. This study presents an effective proactive ARP spoofing defense that uses SDN's centralized control and programmability features. The system continually analyzes ARP packets, keeps an accurate logical and physical address mapping, and dynamically adds flow restrictions to prevent malicious hosts from imitating legitimate devices. The proposed system identifies and prevents single and multiple source ARP spoofing attacks in real-time at O(1) processing cost, resulting in low network overhead. The experiment conducted on an SDN-simulated environment proved that the Ryu controller can mitigate ARP spoofing attempts while preserving legitimate network activities. Furthermore, the proposed technique can scale in terms of network capacity and traffic volume. The proposed automated and scalable ARP spoofing approach enhances SDN cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal Crime Prediction for Women’s Safety in India Using a Hybrid CNN-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The safety of women is very important as crimes against women are rising daily, especially in India, and this has led to a strong need for predictive models that can help policymakers prevent crime. This study suggests a hybrid deep learning model for spatiotemporal crime prediction that combines Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Convolutional neural networks can extract spatial features from the data and the LSTM extracts the sequential data which provides more accuracy. The dataset contains state-wise and district-level data on the crimes that happened against women from 2001 to 2014. The hybrid model outperforms the other traditional models, attaining a 97 % accuracy rate. It is shown that this hybrid architecture performs well in addressing the challenging issue of crime prediction and provides policymakers with useful information to enhance women’s safety. Future studies will focus on real-time crime prediction and the incorporation of socioeconomic factors to improve predictive capabilities.

articleTitle: Autonomous Driving System Using CNN and PPO
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Autonomous driving has emerged as a solution for the problems which a person faces while driving. Autonomous driving technology not only decreases the transportation challenges but also increases safety. This paper presents an autonomous driving algorithm engineered and executed using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), a reinforcement learning (RL) technique, within the Car Learning to Act (CARLA) simulation environment. By keeping in mind, the complexities of Indian roads, such as obstacles or animals on road, unstructured traffic and dynamic conditions, this paper proposes an algorithm designed in a way to adapt these complexities easily. Autonomous driving focuses on two things: Computer Vision and Decision-making. The proposed algorithm prepares a vehicle to be able to work with real world images using the proposed Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model and generate segmented, labelled images which labels each pixel of the image with a specific class. The RL model is trained on these images which shows that the algorithm is safe and more efficient as compared to the existing work. Through extensive simulations the proposed work shows that the proposed algorithm surpasses most of the existing methods in terms of safety and efficiency. Simulation results shown that the proposed PPO-based framework gain 15% more reward and 20% longer episode duration compared to the prior models, indicating its superior adaptability and robustness.

articleTitle: Predicting Public Sector Energy Efficiency with Cloud Data Centre using a Consolidation of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The next generation of data centres along with the ever-increasing demand for power efficiencies in the infrastructure of cloud computing is creating buzz over innovative solutions. Among various techniques towards the optimization of energy costs along with environmentally friendly options, VM (Virtual Machine) consolidation is seen as one of the most viable solutions. Intelligent learning approaches such as machine learning and deep learning have emerged as powerful management tools towards optimization of the resources of a cloud data centre. Since most of these VM migration approaches between the host failed to consider the migration costs with their consideration of total energy consumptions; some include the migration distance and time. We have reviewed more than 40 research paper and discusses different techniques for improving energy efficiency-from SVM (Support Vactor Machine) to Decision trees, Deep learning, and RL (Reinforcement Learning) while comparing and contrasting the approaches used. We focus specifically on RL methodologies and analyse how well they can reduce energy consumption, towards understanding which one has a promising potential in minimizing energy consumption in cloud data centres.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Mango Leaf Disease Detection using Yolov8
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The mango holds a significant position in India's fruit crop rotation and plays a major part in the nation's economy. The best strategy to avoid losing money and time is to recognize diseases in crops earlier. Obtaining a comprehensive dataset can be challenging and time-consuming. Additionally, deep learning models may struggle with detecting early-stage symptoms of diseases. In this work, a novel deep learning-based model is proposed for the early detection of mango leaf disease (MLD). An adaptive unsharp mask-guided (AUG) filter is used as a pre-processing step to improve the input pictures from the collected dataset. The enhanced images are fed into the YOLOV8 model for detecting mango leaf disease (MLD) and classifying the different kinds of disease. According to the experimental result, the proposed model attains a 99.29% success rate for the classification of disease in mango leaf. The proposed approach is compared to DL methods such as SSD, Mask RCNN, and YOLO v8. The detection accuracy is improved by the YOLO network over SSD, Mask R-CNN, and Yolo v8 by 7.57%, 4.89%, and 2.36%, respectively. In comparison to SVM, ANN, and CNN-HOG, the proposed approach advances the overall accuracy range by 4.72%, 0.73%, 13.18%, and 5.44%, respectively.

articleTitle: Utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks to Classify Dry Road Surface Conditions
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The abstract gives the performance metrics of a model developed to estimate dry road surface conditions from impact ratings. The model's high precision and recall on all impact ratings were marvelous, but there were also Impact Rating 1 at a precision of 98.56% and a recall of 98.57%, Impact Rating 2 at 98.52%, Impact Rating 3 at 98.56%, Impact Rating 4 at 98.54%, and Impact Rating 5 equally at 98.54%. With 10,350 photos in the dataset, the model's overall accuracy was 98.55%. These values are also reflected in the F1scores clearly showing that the model had balanced performance within each class. The model further had a marvelous accuracy about all classes in total, standing at 99%. Support values that signify the number of samples for each impact rating ranged from 2,030 to 2,100 samples and were evenly apportioned to support every class to the proportion of 0.20. The consistency strengthens the model's robustness and reliability in its decision to classify dry road surfaces. The combination of the above metrics indicates that the model has the strong potential to judge these grades of road conditions properly, thus having promising applicability in numerous road maintenance, safety assessment, and management infrastructures. In short, high results from the model outcome indicate that the model would assist correctly in improving the strategies to enhance road safety and maintenance by eventually providing high-quality evaluations for roads.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Multi-Class Diagnosis of Parkinson’s Disease: Enhancing Accuracy and Differentiation from Movement Disorders
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease is a progressive neurological disorder that is frequently misdiagnosed due to its symptomatic similarities with other movement-related conditions. Ensuring precise and early diagnosis is essential for effective treatment; however, current diagnostic approaches are often subjective and prone to errors. To overcome these limitations, this study introduces a multi-class classification framework designed to differentiate Parkinson’s disease from related disorders, including Essential Tremor, Atypical Parkinsonism, Secondary Parkinsonism, Multiple Sclerosis, and Healthy Controls. The classification process is structured into three tasks: distinguishing Parkinson’s disease from Healthy Controls, differentiating it from other movement disorders, and performing a multi-class classification that includes Parkinson’s disease, Healthy Controls, and additional disorders. Experimental evaluations indicate that XGBoost achieved an F1-score of 93% for Parkinson’s disease versus Healthy Controls, SVM attained 85% for Parkinson’s disease against other movement disorders, and Logistic Regression yielded 68% accuracy in the multi-class classification. These results highlight the potential of machine learning in providing accurate, scalable, and objective diagnostic solutions for Parkinson’s disease.

articleTitle: Intelligent Alzheimer’s Care: Predictive and Supportive Systems with GNNs and GANs
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Alzheimer is a very hard type of disorder due to the progressive impact on memory functions together with other cognitive and daily performances. Traditional approaches were failing at predicting advance and providing individual treatment. In this, have developed an AI technology project based on GNNs for disease prediction and care management process, for which could not find a precedent; coupled with that, use Generative Adversarial Network for stimulating memory and creating patient-friendly environment. Through training of a single drop of brain imaging, cognitive, and environment data, the created system estimates regions which have been thought to contribute to regional development toward Alzheimer’s disease with an accuracy of 97%. It oversees control of recurrent appointments, increases memory throughput via a user-specific media message and aids in post-discharge appointments, which is useful to patients and caretakers in the goal of bettering their experience and quality of life.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Universal Health ID for Secure Patient Record Access
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Due to their frequent fragmentation and silos, healthcare information systems continue to pose significant challenges in the management of patient data, interoperability, and privacy protection. Current healthcare information exchange mechanisms suffer from critical vulnerabilities such as potential data breaches, inconsistent patient identification, and limited patient control over personal health information. This paper presents a new blockchain-based framework for the Universal Health ID, addressing the systemic limitations of such approaches by providing a decentralized and cryptographically secure access mechanism to patient records. Based on a hybrid architecture that utilizes advanced zero-knowledge proof protocols, designed and implemented a comprehensive system for patient identification and data sharing. The proposed methodology would integrate distributed ledger technology with the sophisticated application of encryption techniques to support end-to-end data integrity, granular access controls, and patient-centric management of information. An empirical analysis revealed that data security metrics improve by 98.7%, and a majority, 92% of health professionals, reported enhanced interoperability, with 85% of the patients exhibiting increased confidence in their data being private. Our findings conclusively prove that blockchain-based universal health ID systems represent a transformative approach to solving modern-day challenges in managing healthcare data, offering scalable, secure, and patient-centric solutions for global health ecosystems.

articleTitle: Deepfake Detection and Mitigation Using Advanced CNN: Ensuring Digital Content Integrity
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Deepfake technology, with its hyper-realistic fake content and backed by AI technologies, presents a serious threat to the authenticity and security of digital content. The study deployed three different machine learning-based models: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and Vision Transformers (ViT) for discrimination of real and fake faces. The model leverages the capabilities of CNN for automatic spatial feature learning from raw data, giving it exceptional performance in the discrimination between real and fake content. Performance measures were made in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score and compared against traditional methods; the model remains a trustworthy contribution towards deepfake detection. Findings indicate that the CNN exceeded others with the highest precisions of up to 92.21%, recall of 90%, F1 score of 93%, and perfect accuracy of 97.25%. The paper further discusses the future developments, for instance, architectural improvements and real-time applications and expanding detection capacity outside visual data for a more formidable approach towards new deepfake formats, such as audio and text. This endeavor lays the groundwork for viable and scalable roads against the rising onslaught on digital media manipulation, ensuring content integrity in an AI-driven world.

articleTitle: Dialect Recognition in Tamil and Telugu: An Integrated Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Dialect recognition is one of the important areas in NLP, which focuses on identifying regional differences within a language. This work explores various approaches, ranging from traditional machine learning algorithms to deep learning architectures, large language models, and insights from previous research to develop high-accuracy dialect recognition systems respectively. Whisper model performed the best with an accuracy of 93.18% in dialect recognition was achieved, demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing linguistic variations. HuBERT achieved 92.86% accuracy but struggles with classification between similar dialects. The aim is to improve dialect recognition accuracy and enhance language understanding through the analysis of speech patterns, acoustic features, and linguistic characteristics. This research responds to the critical need for dialect-specific language resources, bridging gaps in speech recognition and machine translation. Our work makes an important contribution based on better communication and social cohesion among speakers of the Tamil and Telugu languages.

articleTitle: Leveraging EfficientNetB5 for Accurate Classification of Diverse Human Cancer Tissues
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The paper investigates the use of a fine-tuned EfficientNetB5 model for human cancer tissue sample categorizing. From Kaggle ten thousand high-resolution images across nine categories: ADI (Adipose), Back (Background), Deb (Debris), LYM (Lymphocytes), MUC (Mucus), MUS (Muscle), NORM (Normal), STR (Stroma), and TUM (Tumour). The model was improved via transfer learning using pre-trained weights and customized for the specific objective of cancer tissue classification. Among the techniques of data augmentation applied to increase generalizing power of the model and reduce overfitting were rotation, flips, and colour changes. The fine-tuned EfficientNetB5 model showed useful general accuracy of 90% in differentiating several tissue types. Especially in differentiating malignant (TUM) and non-cancerous (NORM) tissues, performance measures including precision (0.91), recall (0.89), and F1-score (0.90) verified the model's remarkable performance. The confusion matrix analysis showed that the model could correctly categorize tumour and normal tissues, but the proof of good discrimination between multiple tissue types exposed This work highlights the prospects of using deep learning, especially EfficientNetB5, in automating cancer tissue classification, so providing a realistic approach to raise diagnosis accuracy and efficiency in cancer pathology. Future research will concentrate on improving the model and customizing it to certain cancer forms thereby increasing its relevance in therapeutic environments.

articleTitle: Prediction of Land use and Land cover using Google Earth Engine (GEE) and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Spatiotemporal distribution of Land Use and Land Cover changes, in addition to a variety of socio-ecological concerns, including the links between human activity, physical surroundings, and decadal shifts in LULC caused by anthropogenic activities, are all important topics that can be studied using satellite imagery. This study explores the spatial-temporal assessment of land features and sensitive ecosystem for 2013-2023, with a focus on predicting future land characteristics. Using the CA-Markov chain model, the research forecasts potential changes to the landscape and evaluates their impact on changes of Land features. Images were classified into four classes using Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Naïve Baye (NB), and Classification and Regression Tree (CART). After that, kappa statistics as well as overall accuracy techniques were used to gauge their accuracy. This study used the northern region of India, Dehradun, as a case study. Three Landsat-8 Images were used in this study which is obtained in 2013, 2018 and 2023. The satellite images were obtained from United States Geological Survey (USGS). Finally, this paper reveals that the land features has been identified from 2013-2018 and 2018-2023 and predicted the next 5 years using different social, environmental and physical parameters. From 2013-2018 Vegetation are decreased from 19.53% to 14.33% and the buildup areas are decreased from 11.1% to 5.53% within 5 years interval while from 2018-2023 Vegetation are decreased again from 14.33% to 9.76% while buildup areas increased from 5.53% to 7.37% within 5 years interval. If this trend continues, it looks that vegetation areas will permanently lose their unique traits and ecosystems, having a severe influence on Dehradun meanwhile the buildup areas are predicted to increase within the next 5 years.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Amazon Musical Instruments Reviews using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: This paper delves into sentiment analysis of Amazon musical instruments reviews, employing a comprehensive data science methodology. With a dataset comprising 10,261 rows and 9 columns from Kaggle, the analysis navigates through data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and the crucial task of labeling products based on customer ratings. The sentiment labels—Positive for ratings > 3.0, Neutral for ratings = 3.0, and Negative otherwise—pave the way for subsequent text preprocessing. N-gram analysis becomes a pivotal exploration, unraveling insights from unigrams to trigrams. The impact of retaining "not" in the list of stop words is noted, influencing the sentiment interpretation. Visualization through word clouds further illuminates sentiments. Feature engineering involves dropping insignificant columns, encoding the target variable, TF-IDF vectorization, and resampling the dataset using SMOTE. Model selection unfolds with a thorough evaluation of six classification models through 10-fold cross-validation, culminating in the identification of Logistic Regression as the optimal choice. Hyperparameter tuning refines the model, achieving a notable accuracy of 94.80% on the test set. The conclusion synthesizes key findings: the dataset's focus on guitars, the efficacy of Logistic Regression in sentiment analysis, and the necessity for considering alternative cross-validation methods like Stratified K-Fold. Additionally, the suggestion to explore data scaling is made for future enhancements. The paper illuminates the nuances of sentiment in musical instrument reviews, providing valuable insights for both sellers and consumers in the e-commerce domain.

articleTitle: Automated Retinal Disease Classification: Leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks for Early Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Retinal diseases—including diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration (AMD), and retinal vein occlusion—are main causes of vision impairment and blindness worldwide, therefore profoundly influencing health and wellbeing. Early diagnosis and intervention are key to preventing significant vision loss; nevertheless, sometimes specific tools and qualified professionals are required by standard diagnosis methods, therefore limiting access. This work employs CNNs in a unique approach for automatic eye illness classification. The proposed CNN model learns to identify and categorize various retinal disorders efficiently using a 2,560-tagged retinal picture dataset acquired from the Kaggle platform, hence promoting innovation. The architecture is aimed to extract hierarchical components from retinal images, hence enhancing classification accuracy. With an overall accuracy of 82% on an external test set, the model was able, following analysis, to identify and classify retinal diseases. Faster and more accurate diagnosis helps CNNs considerably lower the load on healthcare providers, improve patient outcomes, and boost better education for medical professionals. Future studies will focus on enhancing the performance of the model by means of additional optimization and validation on more extensive, more varied datasets, therefore guaranteeing its sustainability for practical uses in retinal disease diagnosis and management.

articleTitle: Improving Grape Quality in Viticulture with Autonomous Robots Using Deep Learning and Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The pursuit of enhancing grape quality in viticulture has increased with the emergence of autonomous robots using advanced artificial intelligence (AI) methods. This research introduces an innovative methodology that combines deep learning (DL) and sensor fusion with Region-Based Convolutional Neural Networks (R-CNN) to enhance precision viticulture. Autonomous robots with multispectral and RGB cameras roam vineyards independently, taking high-resolution images and environmental data. The R-CNN algorithm analyses this data to precisely detect grape diseases, evaluate fruit ripeness, and monitor overall vineyard health. The technology employs sensor fusion to integrate visual data with environmental characteristics, enhancing predictions and insights on grape quality. Field investigations indicate substantial improvements in grape output and quality with quick interventions informed by automated evaluations. Findings highlight the capability of integrating robots with DL techniques to transform vineyard management, resulting in sustainable practices and improved production efficiency. The R-CNN-based robotic system demonstrated 95% accuracy in evaluating grape quality, improving efficiency and reducing the need for manual inspections.

articleTitle: SmartHarvest: Advancing Precision Agriculture Techniques for Enhanced Sustainable Crop Yield Management
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Agriculture is a crucial pillar of India’s economy, providing livelihoods and engagement for a significant portion of its population. However, contemporary farmers encounter numerous difficulties, including enhancing crop yields, managing resources sustainably, and navigating an increasingly uncertain climate. This research examines machine learning (ML) practices that aid crop production planning by studying complex environmental and soil parameters like nutrients, temperature, humidity, and precipitation. Various ML models were examined, such as Logistic Regression (LR), RF (Random Forest), Gradient Boosting, SVM, NB (Naive Bayes), Decision Trees, and KNN (K-Nearest Neighbors), using a dataset containing 2,200 entries from different crops. Naive Bayes was the most precise model, reaching an accuracy of 99.55%, with Random Forest trailing closely behind at 99.32%. Gradient Boosting, Decision Trees, and KNN had high performance, achieving accuracies of 98.18%, 98.86%, and 97.05%, respectively. SVM and Logistic Regression achieved slightly reduced accuracies of 96.14% and 94.55%, respectively. When models are evaluated by precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy, Naive Bayes consistently performed well in all areas. These results show how machine learning can also give agriculture an extreme facelift, enabling better crop management decisions. Transport (and spread) the technology and improve resource efficiency, cut waste & food security. The research emphasizes the importance of agricultural information in tackling modern farming obstacles.

articleTitle: Enhancing Species Identification with Fine-Tuned ResNet50: Performance Analysis and Classification of Diverse Species
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: This work categorizes various species, including animals, birds, insects, and fish, using a polished ResNet50 architecture. This work is significant since automated species identification is increasingly required in many different fields, including ecological studies, environmental monitoring, and conservation of biodiversity, therefore promoting sustainable ecosystems. Conventional approaches of species identification limit scalability by requiring specialist knowledge and time-consuming nature of operations. This work intends to solve these constraints and offer a scalable, efficient solution for species classification across 29 classes by using deep learning, therefore supporting life on land and life under water. The working dataset consists of 19,141 images; 3,922 for validation and 15,219 for training. Transfer learning helped the ResNet50 model to be tuned and consequently fit the specific classification problem. With this approach, the model achieved an accuracy of 88% indicating its ability in handling several and complex image data. The results indicate that, in automated species identification, the proposed model may be a valuable tool with considerable prospects for uses in wildlife conservation and biodiversity studies, therefore complementing the aims of climate action.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection and Classification Using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Brain tumor detection and classification play a crucial role in medical imaging, where timely and accurate diagnosis can significantly impact patient health. This study proposes an approach that uses Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for detecting and classifying brain tumors based on MRI imaging data. LSTM, a type of recurrent neural network (RNN), is well-suited for processing sequential data, making it ideal for medical image analysis. The model processes a sequence of MRI images through a pipeline that extracts key features, which are then analyzed by the LSTM network for brain tumor detection and classification. The model has been trained on a dataset containing artificial brain tumors, allowing it to distinguish between false positives and negatives with high accuracy. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of LSTM techniques compared to traditional machine learning algorithms. The performance of the model in both detection and classification tasks has significantly improved due to the precision provided by the LSTM-based approach. The system demonstrates great potential for assisting radiologists by providing valuable diagnostic information and has the potential to improve patient outcomes. The model has achieved an accuracy of 95%. The dataset used in this study includes 7,022 brain MRI images, of which 300 contain glioma, 306 contain meningioma, 405 contain no tumor, and 300 are labeled as no tumor.

articleTitle: Time-Series Analysis in Epilepsy Prediction using Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN)
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Time-series analysis in epilepsy prediction involves analysing temporal patterns in neural activity such as EEG signals to detect changes that precede seizures. This work aims at evaluating the performance of Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) for time-series analysis of the EEG signal in epilepsy prediction. Because of the ability to model intricate temporal dependencies. Initially, are gathered from archives and clinical investigations and the input EEG signals are pre-processed to remove noise artefacts, scaled and segmented into frames. Feature extraction methods are applied to derive key characteristics from the signals, followed by Principal component analysis (PCA) and recursive feature removal are two feature selection techniques that are used to find the most pertinent characteristics. The TCN model, designed to capture short- and long-term EEG patterns, is trained using stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with a set learning rate. Pre-processed signals and selected features serve as inputs, while labels, indicating pre-ictal or ictal states, form the output. The whole approach is written in Python and leading machine learning frameworks, including TensorFlow and PyTorch. The final model is deployed as a web application as a Flask application so that clinicians and researchers can upload the EEG signals and get real-time predictions. The accuracy and AUC-ROC of the suggested TCN model were 88.7% and 90%, respectively.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection: A CNN-LSTM Autoencoder Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Due to the significant growth of video surveillance installations in recent years, video anomaly detection has attracted considerable interest in the security sector. Detecting anomalies in video is a crucial task within the realm of smart security. The intricacy and diversity of real-world data can present challenges for conventional methods, leading to decreased accuracy. In this paper, we introduce a robust system for identifying anomalies in surveillance footage by employing a deep-learning-driven unsupervised anomaly detection technique that relies on a reconstruction approach. Our architecture employs an autoencoder with CNN and LSTM layers to extract local and motion characteristics from the video frames. The evaluation of the proposed model is conducted using benchmark datasets, UCSD Pedestrian 1 and UCSD Pedestrian 2. The performance of our model was noticeably superior to that of the other competing models, with AUC and EER values of 99.1% and 6.4% for Ped1, 98.5% and 4.4% for Ped2, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimization of Resource and Energy in Distributed Systems Using Unified Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Cloud and large distributed systems must ensure resource scheduling, energy management, and resource allocation. However, there exist complex and dynamic workloads, which may cause inefficient resource distribution, increased energy consumption, cost of operation and time delays which ultimately lead to reduced Quality of Experience (QoE). To address these issues the Unified Genetic Algorithm (UGA) is proposed, a proactive approach in optimization which helps achieve relatively better balance between CPU and memory usage across multiple nodes in a distributed system. UGA, was tested using the Materna workload trace and subjected to comparison with other existing load balancing algorithms such as Firefly, Coral Reef Optimization and Novel Family. It is found that UGA is superior with regard to efficiency in scheduling as it has revealed an improvement of 6.72% in average when compared to state of the art algorithms and proved to be beneficial in optimal resource allocation and improvement in system performance.

articleTitle: Lightweight Facial Expressions Analysis with MobileNet
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Facial expressions recognition is an exciting study area within Computer vision applications affecting estimating and human-calculating interaction. The detection and categorization of seven universal emotional states such as anger, neutrality, sad, fear, pleasure, disgust, surprise, face expression are essential in various computer vision applications. The primary focus of this study is on the extraction and categorization of these expressions using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Over the last 10 years, CNNs and MobileNet have been a prominent focus of human-computer interaction research because of their superior feature-learning capabilities. Current models perform much worse on real-time, uncontrolled datasets than they do on controlled laboratory datasets while exhibiting remarkable accuracy in facial emotion recognition. Issues including deteriorated picture quality, occlusions, fluctuating illumination, and changes in head posture are frequently seen in photos taken from unstructured sources like the internet. By using deep learning approaches to interpret real-time photos, especially those with lesser quality, the goal here is to increase FER's recognition accuracy. For the experiment's purpose, FER2013 and Random dataset are utilized. The proposed method outperforms existing methods in accuracy, achieving a Train Accuracy of 50% and Validation Accuracy of 55% on benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework with Large Language Models for Enhanced Public Health Response
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Healthcare and biomedical industries produce massive amounts of data such as standard operating procedures, protocols, research papers, clinical guidelines, etc. The management and control of this amount of information can limit timely decisions in particular, during emergency situations (e.g., pandemics). Large Language Models (LLMs) can effectively manage this data, but naive implementations are often costly and time-consuming and have limitations such as hallucinations, outdated information, and irretractable thought processes. This research proposes a framework integrating LLMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques and a vector database to enhance data retrieval and generation. The AI-based framework uses a variety of public health data sets consisting of structured and unstructured data, as well as full-text medical references. It addresses the challenges of implementing an RAG pipeline on medical data by developing open-source LLMs integrated with advanced retrieval methods. The framework achieves strong performance with ROUGE-1 precision of 0.6797, recall of 0.816, F-measure of 0.718, and BLEU of 0.4709. It generates accurate responses in 35 seconds, making it efficient for healthcare use. Tackling the key translational issues of deploying RAG pipelines to complex medical text, this study is generalizable to the wider use of LLMs in healthcare, disease prevention, and surveillance. Implementations of this system have the ability to change the world landscape of public health by providing epidemiologists with ongoing, up-to-date information to be used by healthcare practitioners, as well as by enhancing global disease surveillance and response capacity.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Anomaly Detection to Strengthen Internet of Things Security and Forestall Cyber Attacks in Networked Device Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: As millions of devices are linked, the IoT has revolutionized numerous businesses by automating and data-driven decision-making. Due to the proliferation of linked devices, cybercriminals target IoT environments for security breaches. This research examines AI-powered anomaly detection systems for real-time threat discovery and mitigation in IoT security. Advanced machine learning and deep learning models based on artificial intelligence can detect suspicious activity in networked environments and early security breaches. Artificial intelligence systems learn from network traffic and device behaviors to respond to emerging cyber threats, unlike rule-based security solutions. The study found that AI-driven anomaly detection can prevent data breaches, malware outbreaks, and DDoS attacks. This study compares artificial intelligence algorithms for real-time anomaly detection across IoT frameworks. Supervised, unsupervised, and hybrid learning models are used. It also discusses the challenges of large-scale AI system deployment, including the need for high-quality labelled datasets for training and computational resource constraints. The results suggest that AI-enabled anomaly detection could become a crucial part of IoT security, adapting to the growing number of connected devices.

articleTitle: Automating Crop Identification: A Deep Learning Approach Using ResNet50V2 in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Aiming at automating the identification of different crop kinds from images, this research study offers an agricultural crop classification model utilizing the ResNet50V2 deep learning architecture. Precision agriculture's developments depend much on accurate crop classification to monitor and control agricultural activities. This work trains the model using a dataset of images of thirty various cropping. Model generalization is improved by means of rescaling, rotation, and horizontal flipping among data augmentation methods. The efficacy of the model is assessed using performance measures and achieved an accuracy of 0.96, a confusion matrix is utilized to show classification results. Particularly for crops like "Lemon," "Cotton," and "Soyabean," the model shows great classification accuracy. But because of their apparent resemblance, some crops like "Cherry" and "Cardamom" create classification problems. With further improvements suggested to improve performance for demanding classes, the results show the model's capacity to support precision agriculture by allowing automated crop identification. This work emphasizes how well deep learning models might transform agricultural resource management and crop monitoring.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Indian Coin Classification Using CNN and KNN
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The summary emphasizes the successful deployment of a strong coin class model tailored specially for Indian coins. The model has tremendous overall performance measures, including high precision, keep in mind, and F1 rankings throughout a couple of denominations. For example, the 1 rupee coin had a precision, don’t forget, and F1-rating of 98.59, while the 2 rupee coin marginally outperformed it with values of 98.62. The 10 and 20 rupee coins likewise had top metrics, scoring 98.64 and 98.60, respectively. Although the 5 rupee coin had barely decreased outcomes (accuracy, bear in mind, and F1-rating of 95.65), it demonstrated amazing categorization abilities. With 10,870 pics as a dataset, the fashions used yielded a normal accuracy of 98.62%. The model’s performance is in addition supported by way of balanced magnificence distributions, as indicated through the support values: 2,130 for the 1 Rupee, 2,180 for the 2 Rupee, 2,220 for the 5 Rupee, 2,220 for the 10 Rupee, and 2,140 for the 20 Rupee cash, all of which contribute to a steady accuracy of 0.99 (99%) in all training. This consistency no longer handiest will increase the version’s trustworthiness however also helps its suitability to be used in automatic coin reputation structures. The version’s excessive type accuracy suggests that it’s miles well-appropriate to supporting users in reliably figuring out diverse Indian coin denominations, making it a vital device for monetary transactions and automated merchandising systems. Overall, the consequences display the cautioned model’s usefulness and performance in fixing the issues of coin categorization in real-world circumstances.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Vehicle Counting and Speed Estimation in Surveillance Videos using Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: This paper introduces a Deep Learning-based Vehicle Counting and Speed Estimation (VCSE) system. The proposed VCSE system applies object detection techniques and custom-developed algorithms on surveillance videos. For object detection, the system uses the Single-Shot Detection algorithm and fine-tuned MobileNetV2 CNN over a custom dataset. Moreover, it uses a custom-developed algorithm for object tracking and speed estimation. After fine-tuning object detection model, the mAP score for object detection was 0.88. The parameters of the speed estimation algorithm were also fine-tuned using a curated calibration dataset that contains videos of the vehicles with varying direction, speed and environment. The accuracy of the speed estimation was around 98% after calibration. The proposed VCSE system finds its applications in law enforcement, smart-city planning and traffic management. It is a valuable tool for enhancing the safety and security posture of an organization by monitoring the vehicles’ speed on a real-time and 24/7 basis.

articleTitle: Automated Heart Arrhythmia Detection and Health Advisory System with Auto ML
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The advanced AutoML platform shows exceptional results in heart arrhythmia detection using deep learning technologies which reach 98% accuracy. Our evaluation methods show that the system detects 98% of events while missing only 2.8% with an F1-score of 97.8%. Our product stimulates patient involvement with its real-time ECG tool as well as customized healthcare services. Users connect more actively by 30%. Our system helps doctors see more patients each day by saving 40% of planning time and creating readable records to watch patients' heart health. The system works well with healthcare procedures while keeping patient data safe and following healthcare rules. In many patient care settings this platform shows problems in the cardiovascular system sooner which leads to better management and enhanced health results for patients. This system harnesses analytical tools and creates meaningful results to substantially improve cardiovascular healthcare delivery. The system identifies patterns based on advanced machine learning technology so it improves its accuracy and performance in every medical setting.

articleTitle: Enhancing Crop Yield Prediction Through Time Series Forecasting with XGBOOST Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Agriculture is the only sector in the country that benefits everyone. It gives a large section of the population work possibilities in addition to food and raw materials. The primary source of income for the vast majority of Indians is agriculture. Although agriculture has been practiced in the nation for thousands of years, outdated agricultural methods have been replaced by modern machinery and technology. The importance of integrating technology into agriculture is growing as it spreads throughout all sectors of the economy. Machine learning facilitates large-scale data processing and has the potential to yield faster, more accurate results. These advantages can be used to recognize risky situations as well as lucrative possibilities. The main goal of this research is to create a model using Machine Learning which implements all the Classification algorithm to predict the crop yields. For Prediction of crop yield, firstly the data is taken and trained by using Machine Learning’s type that is Supervised Machine Learning with different types of Models, which calculates the Mean square value(MSE), Mean absolute Error(MAE), Root square (R2). The resultant provides XGBOOST as a best predicting Algorithm. After that the data is now trained by using XGBOOST algorithm which proves the accuracy of prediction.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Classifying Severity of Dysgraphia
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: The ability to accurately detect and assess the severity of dysgraphia is pivotal for providing timely intervention and support to affected individuals. This paper explores the application of Deep learning model to evaluate the severity of dysgraphia by analyzing handwriting samples. VGG16 model, a trained CNN renowned for its exceptional ability to recognize images is employed. The objective is to classify handwriting samples into 'Low Potential Dysgraphia' and 'Potential Dysgraphia'. The Dysgraphia image datasets is preprocessed to align with the VGG16 model’s input requirements to ensure reliability by adjusting each images resolution to 224 x 224 pixels and using a batch size of 32. The model is trained over 10 epochs for optimal learning performance. The VGG16 model is effectively assessed based on the performance metrics viz; accuracy, precision, loss, recall, F1 score. VGG16 significantly achieves a test accuracy rate of 92%, showcasing its proficiency in classifying handwriting associated with dysgraphia.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven URL Analysis for Enhanced Threat Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: Phishing, malware, defacement, and other malicious URLs are among the most significant online threats today. Traditional methods for detecting such threats rely on static blacklisting, which fails to adapt to the evolving malicious URL patterns. This article proposes a user-friendly approach using machine learning-based techniques, supported by an intuitive interface that can analyze URLs in real-time. Unlike existing solutions, which struggle with generalization or feature selection, our approach enhances adaptability by leveraging a wider range of structural, linguistic, and contextual URL features. Experiments have been performed using different machine learning models, including Decision Trees, K-nearest Neighbors, and Random Forest. From the results obtained, it has been observed that Random Forest does reasonably well with 89% in accuracy, proving that a lot of improvement by training the model on diverse data and labeled URLs. The tool first extracts numerical features from URL structures, so users can input any URL in real time and receive numerical ranking assessments regarding security risks. Future work will be on improving the adaptability of the model and enhancing user understanding through explainable AI techniques.

articleTitle: Integrating AI into Sustainable Human Resource Management: Driving Organizational Resilience and Performance
publicationTitle: 2025 3rd International Conference on Advancement in Computation & Computer Technologies (InCACCT)
abstract: This research employs Artificial Intelligence (AI) is being used in this research to analyse the adoption and effects of Sustainable Human Resource Management (SHRM) practices in diverse organizations.
